body.resource_hint: On the kappa-Hilbertized carrier Omega*=Upsilon, so the auxiliary pair is a positive free complex scalar. For compact h, A=D_Omega(h) and B=D_Upsilon(h) are densely defined local quadratic Wick polynomials with A* extending D_Upsilon(conj h) and B* extending D_Omega(conj h). Hence K psi=(A psi,B psi) is closable. For its closure, V=[[0,K*],[K,0]] is self-adjoint, with explicit resolvent at z=+/-i built from (I+K*K)^-1 and (I+KK*)^-1. Locality of the Wick polynomials makes V affiliated with the matrix-amplified dual free-field algebra; its bounded Borel calculus gives U_g=exp(-igV) and E_click=sin^2(g|K|). The charged pointer makes V total-charge neutral and ghost even. A phase-reversed ground/click input contrast has derivative determined by <v,Ku>, so the certified nonzero q8 transition is operational without a nonlocal field-vacuum effect.
